salesHint: Every sale made at your tills. Open one to see what was sold, print the receipt, void it or take goods back.
returnsHint: Goods taken back from customers. Large refunds wait here until a manager approves them.
tillsHint: Each cashier's till session: cash in the drawer, what was sold and whether the cash counted at the end matched.
devicesHint: The tills, tablets and phones that are allowed to sell. Each one has its own key.
noSalesHint: Sales appear here as soon as a cashier completes one at a till.
tryOtherFilters: Try a different day, till or status.
saleNotFound: This sale could not be opened
voidedNote: This sale was voided. Its payments, stock and accounts entries were reversed.
voidWarning: Use this only while the till is still open. The payments are reversed, the goods go back into stock and the accounts are corrected. After the till is closed, record a return instead.
returnHint: Enter how many of each item the customer is bringing back. Each is refunded at the price it really sold for.
restockHint: Leave as default to use the till's own store.
returnApprovalHint: A large refund may wait for a manager's approval before any money moves.
returnPending: {{number}} is waiting for a manager's approval.
noReturnsHint: When a customer brings goods back they appear here.
noTillsHint: A session starts when a cashier opens a till with a cash float.
noTillsMatch: No till session matches these filters.
tillNotFound: This till session could not be opened
closeTillHint: Count the cash in the drawer and enter it. If it differs from what was expected you will be asked why.
name: Name
storeHint: The store this device's sales take stock from.
noDevicesHint: Register each till, tablet or phone that will sell. You get a key to put on it.
deviceNameHint: For example Counter 1 or Mobile van.
deviceCodeHint: Short code used in receipt numbers, up to 8 characters.
blockAsk: Block {{name}}? It cannot sell or sync until you unblock it. Use this for a lost or stolen device.
newKeyAsk: Give {{name}} a new key? The old key stops working at once and the device must be set up again with the new one.
keyOnce: This key is shown only once. Copy it now and put it on the device.
receiptTextHint: A line printed at the bottom, such as a thank-you or return policy.

reasonLists.price_override: Reasons for changing a price or giving a discount

reasonListHints.void: Cashiers and managers pick one when they void.
reasonListHints.sale_return: Picked when goods are taken back.
reasonListHints.price_override: Needed when a price differs from the list or a discount is given.
reasonListHints.till_variance: Picked when the cash counted differs from what was expected.

label: Label
reasonCodeHint: A short code, for example DAMAGED.
noteRequiredLabel: Ask for a note when this reason is chosen
noReasonsHint: Add the reasons your staff will choose from.
changeStoreHint: The store this till's sales take stock from. You cannot change it while a till is open on this device.
storeChanged: {{name}} now sells from the new store.
noStoreYet: This branch has no store yet, so a till here cannot sell.
